programme.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation

programme.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation

programme.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation

programme.desc: S7 E7 — Episode 7 Paul and Nicole of the Special Operations Response Team are called after a mobility scooter plunges down a steep embankment. The crew work closely with fire and rescue to lower a paramedic down by rope to administer vital pain relief to the patient. Thoughts then turn to how the emergency services can get the patient to safety. In Edinburgh, teammates Kevin and Martyn respond to a 999 call from a concerned member of the public after a man is found unconscious in the city centre. They arrive to find that the patient is a familiar face - a homeless man with an alcohol dependency, and who is a frequent user of the ambulance service. Not long after taking this unfortunate patient to hospital, the team receive another 999 call - the same man has been found passed out in the street, having absconded from A&E. The crew now face the dilemma of how to best treat this struggling person.
programme.title: Paramedics On Scene

programme.desc: S8 E6 — The Mind of Evil: Episode 2 A full scale riot takes place at the Prison and Jo is taken hostage. Meanwhile, at the World Peace conference, the Chinese delegate’s aid prepares to kill the American delegate.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S8 E7 — The Mind of Evil: Episode 3 The Master is behind the Keller Machine and uses it to recruit the rioting inmates at Stangmoor Prison. He plans to capture a missile and fire it at the World Peace Conference.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S8 E8 — The Mind of Evil: Episode 4 The mind parasite within the Keller Machine becomes too powerful for the Master to control. It learns how to move of its own accord and goes on the hunt for new minds.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S8 E9 — The Mind of Evil: Episode 5 The Master forms an uneasy alliance with the Doctor so that between them they can subdue the Keller Machine which is now out of control.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S8 E10 — The Mind of Evil: Episode 6 The Keller Machine breaks free of the Doctor’s restraining device and the Doctor has no choice but to turn the parasite against the Master.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S8 E11 — The Claws of Axos: Episode 1 Axos lands on Earth. The Axons ask only to be allowed to repair their damaged ship and offer the gift of the miraculous Axonite in return. But the Axons aren’t all that they seem.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S8 E12 — The Claws of Axos: Episode 2 The Master is in league with the Axons who intend to consume the Earth. The Doctor subjects Axonite to tests and discovers the terrible truth.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S8 E13 — The Claws of Axos: Episode 3 The Axons reveal their true nature and attempt to obtain the secret of time travel. Meanwhile, the Master, forced to work for UNIT, concocts a plan to strike back at Axos.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S8 E14 — The Claws of Axos: Episode 4 With Axos poised to destroy the world, the Doctor appears to switch sides and allies himself with the Master. Together they plan to escape the Earth, leaving it to Axos.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E8 — The Daleks: The Ambush Pretending to be a Dalek, Ian finds that that he is trapped inside the casing. The Doctor, Susan and Barbara have no choice but to abandon Ian as the real Daleks arrive and attack.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E5 — The Daleks: The Dead Planet The travellers venture out on to the surface of a new world. Everything is dead but beyond a petrified jungle they see a huge metal city which the Doctor is determined to explore.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E7 — The Daleks: The Escape Fearful of a Thal attack, the Daleks force Susan to trick the Thals. Realising that the Daleks are planning an ambush, the four travellers try to escape and warn the Thals.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E9 — The Daleks: The Expedition Ian and Barbara join a Thal expedition that will penetrate the Dalek city from the unguarded mountains behind it. Their journey is a dangerous one and not all will survive.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E10 — The Daleks: The Ordeal The Doctor and Susan are once again taken prisoner by the Daleks. In the mountains, Ian, Barbara and the Thals must negotiate a vast chasm to reach the city.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E11 — The Daleks: The Rescue The Thals and the time travellers attack the Daleks from all sides as the Daleks start the countdown to release deadly doses of radiation into the atmosphere.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E6 — The Daleks: The Survivors Looking for Barbara, the Doctor, Ian and Susan discover that they have exposed to lethal doses of radiation. The travellers are confronted by the city’s inhabitants – the Daleks!
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E13 — The Edge of Destruction: The Brink of Disaster As the power of the TARDIS threatens to escape and destroy the ship, the travellers become increasingly paranoid and hostile towards each other.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E12 — The Edge of Destruction: The Edge of Destruction The TARDIS is suspended in space and the Doctor, Ian, Barbara and Susan are confused and frightened by a series of inexplicable events.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E25 — The Keys of Marinus: Sentence of Death Arriving in the city of Millennius, Ian is put on trial for murder. The Doctor takes on the role of defence counsel and must prove Ian's innocence or he will be executed.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E26 — The Keys of Marinus: The Keys of Marinus The Doctor solves the murder mystery and finds the final missing key. With Ian now free, the travellers return to the island only to discover that Arbitan has been murdered.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E23 — The Keys of Marinus: The Screaming Jungle Ian and Barbara find a temple in the middle of a hostile jungle. Inside is the ailing Darrius, keeper of one of the keys. As Darrius dies he gives Ian a clue to find the key.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E21 — The Keys of Marinus: The Sea of Death The TARDIS lands on a remote island, surrounded by a sea of acid. They meet Arbitan, keeper of the Conscience of Marinus who forces the travellers to go in search of five keys.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E24 — The Keys of Marinus: The Snows of Terror In a snowy wasteland, Vasor, an unscrupulous trapper, imprisons the travellers in a frozen cavern inside a mountain. There they find one of the keys frozen in a block of ice.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who
